description: E-Bike Survey Response Results is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. Between April 10 and May 8, 2013 the City of Toronto posted an online survey, which sought to gather demographic, travel and public opinion data to better understand e-bikes, and how City of Toronto policy should be directed to incorporate them into Toronto's Transportation mix. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. Its tags are e-bike. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLS. The portal shows 2023-04-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
